## Setup

Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(ggtext)
library(systemfonts)
library(showtext)
library(scales)
library(tidytext)

options(scipen = 999)

```

Fonts
```{r}
font_add_google(
  name = "Inter", 
  family = "inter"
)

font_add_google(
  name = "PT Sans Caption", 
  family = "ptsans"
)

# enable `ggplot` to use google fonts
showtext.auto()

```

## Data
```{r}
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2026-04-21')

financing_schemes <- tuesdata$financing_schemes
health_spending <- tuesdata$health_spending
spending_purpose <- tuesdata$spending_purpose

```


## Tidy & Explore

Health spending
```{r}
health_spending |> 
  group_by(expenditure_type) |> 
  summarise(n = n())

health_spending |> 
  filter(country_name == 'Afghanistan' & year == 2002)

health_spending |> 
  group_by(country_name) |> 
  summarise(n=n())

```

Spending purpose
```{r}
spending_purpose |> 
  arrange(desc(value))

# explore preventative vs curative 
spending_purpose |> 
  group_by(spending_purpose) |> 
  summarise(n = n())

spending_purpose |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = spending_purpose, y= value)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  coord_flip()

spending_purpose |> 
  filter(iso3_code == "USA" & unit == 'constant 2023 US$') |> #USA
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = spending_purpose)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  labs(title = "USA Healthcare Spending") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-12), 
                     limits = c(0,4e12))

spending_purpose |> 
  filter(iso3_code == "CHN" & unit == 'constant 2023 US$') |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = spending_purpose)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  labs(title = "China Healthcare Spending") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale = 1e-12), 
                     limits = c(0,4e12))


```

In both US and China, curative care spending between 2026 and 2022 outpaced all other healthcare spending combined. In both countries, it has risen sharply since 2016. 

## Plot

```{r}
spending_purpose |> 
  filter(iso3_code %in% c("CHN", "USA") &  unit == 'constant 2023 US$') |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = country_name)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~spending_purpose)

spending_purpose |> 
  group_by(spending_purpose) |> 
  summarise(n = n())

spending_purpose |> 
  filter(iso3_code %in% c("CHN", "USA") &  
           unit == 'constant 2023 US$' & 
           spending_purpose %in% c("Curative care", "	Preventive care", "Governance, and health system and financing administration", "Medical goods (non-specified by function)") &
           year %in% c(2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = value, color = country_name)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~spending_purpose, nrow=3)

```
